overview: Based on the published agenda, the Wausau School District Board of Education was scheduled to convene in a closed session on September 21, 2026, to hold a pupil expulsion hearing. The Board was expected to deliberate privately and potentially take action in closed session as necessary and appropriate, with the option to reconvene in open session for any further proceedings.

agenda.item: Motion to convene in closed session pursuant to s. 19.85(1)(a), (f), and (g), and s. 118.125 of the Wisconsin Statutes to hold a pupil expulsion hearing

discussions.body: The Board was scheduled to convene in closed session to hold a pupil expulsion hearing pursuant to Wisconsin Statutes s. 19.85(1)(a), (f), and (g), as well as s. 118.125. The Board was expected to deliberate privately at the conclusion of the hearing and may take action in closed session if necessary and/or appropriate. Following the closed session, the Board was scheduled to consider reconvening in open session and may take further action if necessary and/or appropriate.

publicComment: No public comment period was included on this agenda.
